name: robots/cognitiveaisystems__mikasa-robo
title: MIKASA-Robo BunchOfColors3-v0 (memory manipulation simulation)
intro: MIKASA-Robo BunchOfColors3-v0 (memory manipulation simulation), adapted from cognitiveaisystems/mikasa-robo. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
